description:
A basic material that can be processed to make
anything from buildings to tools.
name: Wood

description:
Material used for sturdier tools. 
Can be split to make sharp edges.
name: Stone

description: Hardens when baked. Useful for making pottery and repairs.
name: Clay

description: A natural substitute for rope. Ideal for simple uses.
name: Vine

description: Has a sharp edge. Big ones can also be used as plates.
name: Seashell

description: Nature's gift which can replace cloth. Softens when tanned.
name: Pelt

description: Lightweight material suitable for arrow fletching.
name: Feather

description:
An item needed to start a fire. It's extremely tough,
so it has other uses as well.
name: Flint

description:
A substitute for strong threads. 
Can be used for bowstrings and sewing.
name: Animal Sinew

description:
Floating debris that can be used for insulation or
as buoyancy materials. Very easy to process.
name: Styrofoam

description:
Can be used as an adhesive or for waterproofing.
Can also be used in ointments.
name: Resin

description: Brittle, but can make sharp blades. Handle with care.
name: Obsidian

description: White crystals used as gunpowder ingredients.
name: Saltpeter

description:
Precious material used to make gunpowder.
Has a sterilizing effect.
name: Sulfur

description:
Remnants of a civilization. 
Can produce sparks when struck against flint.
name: Metal Fragment

description: A big container that can be turned into a bath.
name: Metal Barrel

description: A flotsam with various uses as a waterproof sheet.
name: Plastic Sheet

description: Made by boiling seawater. Can preserve and season food.
name: Salt

description:
A binding material stronger than vines. Good for situations
requiring durability. Might have unexpected uses at sea...
name: Rope

description:
A long-term storable fuel. 
Also effective for water purification.
name: Charcoal

description:
Baked container molded from clay and crushed seashells.
Needs to be baked at the right temperature.
name: Pottery

description:
A natural fever medicine. Tastes bitter.
It can also help with motion sickness... maybe...
name: Herb

description:
A simple fishing rod made from wood, vines, and a shell hook.
Effect: Enables the Fish command.
name: Fishing rod

description:
Improved version with a metal hook and a styrofoam float.
Effect: Difficulty of fishing -4.
name: Improved Fishing Rod

description:
Essential for cutting down trees. Keep the blade sharp.
Effect: Enables the Cut Tree command.
name: Axe

description:
Better axe using flint for greater sharpness and durability.
Effect: Difficulty of cutting trees -4.
name: Improved Axe

description:
Used from skinning to crafting. Always handy to have.
Effect: Enables the Cut Wood and Gather Vines commands.
name: Stone Knife

description:
Made out of obsidian. Has greatly increased sharpness.
Effect: Can work on stone and metal. Gather vines difficulty -4.
name: Obsidian Knife

description:
A tough to handle spear for hunting fish underwater. 
Effect: Heroine will catch additional fish while fishing.
name: Harpoon

description:
Improved with enhanced accuracy. Utilizes animal tendons.
Effect: Increases the success rate of harpoon fishing.
name: Improved Harpoon

description:
A bow-shaped fire starter. Easier to light than by hand.
Effect: Reduces the time required to start a fire.
name: Bow-Drill Fire Starter

description:
Strike flint and steel to use. Works even on rainy days.
Effect: Greatly reduces time required to start a fire.
name: Flint Fire Starter

description:
Wooden chopsticks, spoons, and forks with shell plates.
Effect: Increases WILL restored during dinner.
name: Utensils

description:
Cookware made from pottery. Broadens cooking options.
Effect: Increases chance to make delicious meals for dinner.
name: Cookware

description:
A hunting weapon. Its simple design limits its range.
Effect: Enables Hunt command (requires arrows).
name: Bow

description:
Improved bow using animal sinew. Has increased range.
Effect: Hunting difficulty -4.
name: Improved Bow

description:
Consumable item for use with a bow. Has feather fletching.
Effect: Enables the Hunt command (requires bow).
name: Arrow

description:
Lures birds with bait and traps them in.
Effect: Enables you to set traps in the grassland area.
name: Pen Trap

description:
A trap for small animals. Binds the legs of passing animals.
Effect: Enables you to set traps in the swamp area.
name: Snare Trap

description:
A trap for big animals. Launches arrows using springs.
Effect: Enables you to set traps in the forest area.
name: Arrow Trap

description:
Purifies water using pebbles, gravel, and charcoal.
Effect: Prevents sickness from untreated water. Has other uses...
name: Water Filter

description:
Turns seawater into fresh water using solar heat.
Effect: Acquires one water per day (sunny days only).
name: Seawater Distiller

description:
Produces small amounts of water from plant leaves.
Effect: Acquires one water per day.
name: Dew Collector

description:
A plastic sheet in a depression that collects rainwater.
Effect: Fills up water to max capacity on rainy days.
name: Rain Collector

description:
A tool for signaling your location with thick smoke.
Effect: Can signal for rescue at sea during daytime.
name: Smoke Flare

description:
A tool to make preserved food, but takes time to smoke.
Effect: Allows you to make preserved smoked food (max 3/day).
name: Smoking Rack

description:
Can be used for drying food and clothing.
Effect: Allows you to make preserved dried food (max 3/day).
name: Drying Pole

description:
Used for storage and transport.
Effect: Difficulty of gathering stone -4.
name: Backpack Basket

description:
Can be used for nighttime rescue missions.
Effect: Can signal for rescue at sea during nighttime.
name: Signal Flare

description:
A magnetized metal piece floating on water. Helps with directions.
Effect: Prevents getting lost. Makes it easier to steer a ship.
name: Compass

description:
A mining tool for digging rocks.
Effect: Enables the Mine command.
name: Pickaxe

description:
Improved pickaxe with increased hardness and better grip.
Effect: Mining difficulty -4.
name: Improved Pickaxe

description:
A portable light.
Effect: Allows you to explore the cave area.
name: Torch

description:
Accelerates wound healing. May cause a stinging sensation.
Effect: Prevents mood from going down after getting injured.
name: Ointment

description:
A cracked, nearly broken lighter.
Effect: Allows you to light a fire instantly.
name: Near-Broken Lighter

description:
A mirror the size of a palm.
Effect: Allows you to signal for rescue when at sea.
name: Hand Mirror

description:
A simple shelter with minimal protection from the elements.
Effect: Slightly reduces STA and WILL use while at shelter.
name: Simple Shelter

description:
A reinforced shelter with expanded space.
Effect: Reduces STA and WILL use while at shelter.
name: Shelter

description:
Improved shelter with walls, a roof, and a floor.
Effect: Greatly reduces STA and WILL use while at shelter.
name: Improved Shelter

description:
An unstable vehicle made of wood and vines. Vulnerable to waves.
Effect: Enables the Escape the Island command. Load capacity: 20
name: Raft

description:
Compact vessel with improved stability. Made for the open sea.
Effect: Increases boat speed. Load capacity: 35
name: Boat

description:
Large boat waterproofed via resin. The best weapon for escape.
Effect: Further increases boat speed. Load capacity: 50
name: Improved Boat

description:
Harnesses the wind to propel the boat.
Effect: Required for crafting the raft and the boat.
name: Sail

description:
A waterproof sail whose angles can be adjusted with rope.
Effect: Required to craft the Improved Boat.
name: Improved Sail

description:
Produces charcoal, a high-quality fuel. Takes a lot of time.
Effect: Allows you to produce charcoal.
name: Charcoal Kiln

description:
A metal barrel converted into a fire-heated bathtub.
Effect: Allows you to bathe while at the shelter.
name: Barrel Bath

description:
Uses seawater to cool food. Delays spoilage.
Effect: Delays spoilage of all foods for 1 day.
name: Marine Fridge

description:
Made out of plastic sheets and wood.
Effect: Slightly increases STA and WILL regeneration from sleeping.
name: Simple Bed

description:
A bed with fur underneath for increased comfort.
Effect: Increases STA and WILL regeneration from sleeping.
name: Bed

description:
Comes with a feather pillow. Small comfort in a deserted island.
Effect: Greatly increases STA and WILL regeneration from sleeping.
name: Pillowed Bed

description:
A pond on the sandy beach to keep caught fish alive.
Effect: Extends expiration date of fished food by 1 day.
name: Fish Pond

description:
A stone kiln suitable for cooking and making pottery.
Effect: Allows you to produce pottery.
name: Kiln
レシピチェック用アイテム（表示しない）

description: The basics of survival. May cause diarrhea if not purified.
name: Water Bottle

description: Container for storing water.
name: Empty Water Bottle

description:
Precious food. Eat it before it spoils.
It will expire tomorrow morning.
name: Food (Expires in 0 days)

description:
Precious food. Eat it before it spoils.
It will expire by the morning after tomorrow.
name: Food (Expires in 1 day)

description:
Precious food. Eat it before it spoils.
It will expire in three days, in the morning.
name: Food (Expires in 2 days)

description:
Precious food. Eat it before it spoils.
It will expire in four days, in the morning.
name: Food (Expires in 3 days)

description:
Precious food. Eat it before it spoils.
It will expire in five days, in the morning.
name: Food (Expires in 4 days)

description: Food that can last a long time.
name: Preserved Food
